info.name: Weather
info.summary: Modern weather dashboard with locations, near-term forecast and solar information.
info.description: Weather for Nextcloud 35 provides current conditions, hourly and daily forecasts, sunrise and sunset, device and saved locations, and a weather map with animated radar, wind forecasts at 10/80/120/180 m, storm potential and CHMI ALADIN forecasts. The map supports touch pan and zoom, an optional selected point and a compact menu on mobile devices. Map backgrounds, location services and layout use the required Shared App Core 0.18.1 or newer. The Android widget remains the compact overview supplied by Weather.
info.author: hacesoft
